creatureSize.description: Fixed for most species. A $choice: sentinel where the species lets the player pick, as Human does between Small and Medium - the size is then a build decision like any other, not a property of the species. Widened here rather than in the shared creatureSize enum, which other consumers still need to read strictly.

subFeatures.description: Features a species grants only when a choice selects them, referenced by a choice option's `grants`. Kept apart from `traits` because a trait is something every member of the species has, while these belong to one lineage or ancestry - a Drow feature is not an Elf feature.

choices.description: Decisions belonging to the species itself rather than to any one of its traits. Human's Small-or-Medium size is the case: it is picked when you select the species and feeds `creatureSize`, with no trait to hang it on.
